# Can a Creator Build a House Before Building a Company? — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-81112
Voiceover: The house is visible as both maker attribution and an enduring cataloguing unit.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Gift of Mrs. Philip K. Rhinelander, 1946

Rights: Public Domain / Met Open Access

### 8–16s — B05-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · PRACTICE — What already repeats?. Document the offer, client or audience promise, research method, design sequence, collaborator roles, quality threshold, payment path, correction route, and archive habit. Repetition reveals the institution already operating around the person.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — B05-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · RECORD — Can the practice prove what happened?. Use written scopes, invoices, contributor credits, versioned files, rights and permissions records, contact consent, expense evidence, tax records, and object identifiers appropriate to the actual jurisdiction and activity.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — B05-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · SEPARATE — Which formal questions cannot be solved by good habits?. Entity formation, liability, tax treatment, employment, insurance, securities, licenses, registrations, beneficial ownership, contracting authority, and cross-border activity require fact-specific professional review. A beautiful archive does not create a liability shield.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — B05-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · TRANSITION — What should move when structure arrives?. Inventory names, domains, accounts, agreements, equipment, files, marks, designs, licenses, debts, receivables, privacy obligations, and archive custody. Counsel and advisers must determine what can be assigned, licensed, contributed, retained, or newly contracted.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
